added.text: There is no check-in list: a client reads check-ins through `GET /v1/sync`, and `GET /v1/habits/{habit_id}/completions` answers 405 with code `method_not_allowed`, signed in or not.

removed.text: `GET /v1/habits/{habit_id}/completions` answers `{items, next_cursor, has_more}` with the habit's non-deleted check-ins ordered by date ascending; `?from=` and `?to=` (local dates, inclusive) filter by date, and `from` after `to` answers 422 `validation_failed`.

summary.note: Which workflows fail is mostly not decidable before the change exists: a flow records the answers the app gives today, so it passes today by construction. Before an implementation only a changed invariant (tier 1, observed) and an exact-prefix contradiction (tier 2, determined) decide a workflow; every other flow listed is tier 3 'may_fail' (static, with unknowns), settled by tier 4 (Spike E, observed after the change).
